La "route orientale" comporte de nombreux dangers, notamment des accidents en mer, la traite d'êtres humains et des arrestations arbitraires une fois à terre. En 2025, plus de 900 migrants sont morts ou ont disparu sur cet itinéraire, selon le projet "Missing Migrants" de l'OIM, alors que le nombre de personnes empruntant cette route a augmenté de 18%. L'OIM a qualifié d'alarmante la crise provoquée par les combats au Yémen. Le nombre de déplacés est passé à 200.000, contre 76.000 à la mi-septembre, selon des données publiées par l'agence la semaine dernière. Plus de 3.700 personnes ont fui le Yémen par voie maritime vers Djibouti jusqu'à la semaine dernière, a-t-elle ajouté.

item.title: Arábia Saudita relata feridos em novo ataque a aeroporto de Riad um dia após 13 mortes
item.description: Os houthis do Iêmen, alinhados ao Irã, reivindicaram a autoria do ataque de sábado ao aeroporto internacional de Riad — que deixou 13 mortos e mais de 300 feridos — enquanto autoridades sauditas relataram feridos em um novo ataque ao aeroporto neste domingo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os houthis do Iêmen, alinhados ao Irã, reivindicaram a autoria do ataque de sábado ao aeroporto internacional de Riad — que deixou 13 mortos e mais de 300 feridos — enquanto autoridades sauditas relataram feridos em um novo ataque ao aeroporto neste domingo. A coalizão liderada pela Arábia Saudita no Iêmen informou que um “projétil não identificado” atingiu o aeroporto internacional de Riad no domingo, causando um incêndio. Um número não especificado de pessoas ficou ferido, informou a autoridade de aviação civil da Arábia Saudita, acrescentando que ainda estava avaliando os danos. A coalizão informou ainda que as defesas aéreas sauditas interceptaram um míssil de cruzeiro nas proximidades do Aeroporto Internacional Rei Khalid. Os ataques expuseram vulnerabilidades nas capacidades de defesa da Arábia Saudita, enquanto o reino conduz uma campanha aérea contra os houthis para apoiar a guerra terrestre travada no Iêmen pelo governo iemenita contra o grupo alinhado ao Irã. O aeroporto permanece fechado desde o ataque de sábado. No entanto, uma conferência internacional de energia, planejada há muito tempo, foi realizada em Riad no domingo, conforme o previsto. HOUTHIS ASSUMEM AUTORIA DE OUTROS ATAQUES Em um discurso televisionado no domingo, o porta-voz militar dos houthis, Yahya Saree, assumiu a responsabilidade pelo ataque de sábado e afirmou também que o grupo havia atacado o aeroporto de Dammam, na Província Oriental da Arábia Saudita, e duas instalações da gigante petrolífera saudita Saudi Aramco. Não houve confirmação imediata por parte da Arábia Saudita. A Reuters entrou em contato com o escritório de imprensa saudita e com a Aramco para obter comentários. Anteriormente, os houthis haviam dito em um comunicado no X: “Reiteramos nosso alerta a todas as companhias aéreas, especialistas, funcionários, trabalhadores e viajantes contra o uso de aeroportos e do espaço aéreo sauditas, pois eles estão vulneráveis a ataques e se tornaram um teatro de operações para nossas forças, com exceção dos aeroportos em (cidades sagradas de) Meca e Medina.” “Exortamos todos a levarem nossos alertas a sério, e a Arábia Saudita é responsável por quaisquer interceptações malsucedidas.” A Arábia Saudita intensificou seu envolvimento militar no Iêmen nas últimas semanas, lançando ataques contra os houthis e apoiando uma contraofensiva do governo iemenita depois que o grupo tomou território estratégico ao longo da costa do Mar Vermelho no mês passado. O Ministério das Relações Exteriores do Iêmen, administrado pelos houthis, afirmou no domingo, mais tarde, que novas ações militares sauditas no Iêmen provocariam uma resposta mais forte, acrescentando que suas ações seriam orientadas pelo princípio da reciprocidade. “A menos que o inimigo saudita pare com sua agressão e interferência no Iêmen, o pior ainda está por vir, se Deus quiser”, afirmou o ministério em declarações veiculadas pela emissora de TV Al Masirah, controlada pelos houthis. O presidente Donald Trump disse no sábado que os Estados Unidos estavam considerando se juntar aos ataques sauditas contra os houthis no conflito, uma ramificação da guerra mais ampla contra o Irã que EUA e Israel lançaram em fevereiro.

item.title: Eagles' Jeremiah Trotter Jr., Jags' Bryan Thomas Jr. ejected
item.description: Philadelphia Eagles linebacker Jeremiah Trotter Jr. and Jacksonville Jaguars defensive end Bryan Thomas Jr. were ejected for fighting on the opening kickoff of the teams' game Sunday in London.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Philadelphia Eagles linebacker Jeremiah Trotter Jr. and Jacksonville Jaguars defensive end Bryan Thomas Jr. were ejected for fighting on the opening kickoff of the teams' game Sunday in London. The two players had to be pulled apart at the conclusion of the play, which initially resulted in a 90-yard kickoff return for a touchdown by Jacksonville rookie Josh Cameron. The touchdown, however, was nullified by offsetting penalties, with the Eagles penalized for illegal formation and the Jaguars for holding by linebacker Branson Combs. During the skirmish, Trotter shoved Thomas to the ground before the latter appeared to attempt to kick the former from that position. Trotter, 23, is the son of the four-time Pro Bowl player of the same name who spent eight of his 11 NFL season with the Eagles. Thomas, 22, is an undrafted rookie who was appearing in his fourth career game. --Field Level Media

item.title: Struggling Corinthians sign Seedorf as manager
item.description: Former Netherlands midfielder Clarence Seedorf has returned to a managerial role after seven years, with Brazilian side Corinthians announcing the 50-year-old as their coach on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Former Netherlands midfielder Clarence Seedorf has returned to a managerial role after seven years, with Brazilian side Corinthians announcing the 50-year-old as their coach on Sunday. The former Real Madrid, Inter Milan and AC Milan player had last managed Cameroon, where he was sacked in July 2019. He has joined Corinthians on a contract until the end of the 2027 season, the club said in a statement. Corinthians, who are a point above the relegation zone in the Brazilian Serie A, sacked previous manager Fernando Diniz on Wednesday. Seedorf had terminated his contract with Botafogo to retire as a player and take up his first managerial role at Milan in January 2014. He took over at Milan when they were 11th, and helped them finish eighth, before being dismissed in June. He later coached Shenzhen and Deportivo La Coruna. Corinthians visit second-placed Palmeiras later on Sunday.

item.title: Hamilton apologises as pit lane miss costs Ferrari double podium in Singapore
item.description: Lewis Hamilton's tire troubles mounted as he struggled to match the race pace.
item.dc:creator: Rohith Nair
item.content:encoded: Lewis Hamilton apologised to Ferrari after a failure to enter the pits during a crucial Virtual Safety Car period prevented the Italian team from placing two cars on the podium at Sunday's Singapore Grand Prix. While there was no catching Red Bull's Max Verstappen, who claimed his [USN:L1N45X03I TEXT:"first win in Singapore from pole"], the two Ferraris were second and third when the VSC was triggered by Lance Stroll's retirement. Ferrari boss Fred Vasseur revealed both drivers were called in to change tyres, but Hamilton missed the pit entry while Charles Leclerc successfully stopped and eventually claimed second place after overtaking his teammate. "We all started the race completely blind with the tyres and I think today the soft was much better than the medium. It's why Lewis struggled at the beginning," Vasseur told Sky Sports. "We kept the door open for the two options depending on VSC and that was the case. We called them both to pit. It would have been P2-P3 because we were P2-P3 on track and he missed the pit entry." Hamilton's tyre troubles mounted as he struggled to match the race pace, eventually being overtaken by Leclerc, Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli as well as McLaren's Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri to finish a disappointing sixth. 'I MISSED THE ENTRY' The Briton said he had learned a "painful lesson" but took full responsibility for the call to stay out. "Under the VSC, the team called me in but I missed the entry. After that, I decided to stay out and try to hold track position to the end," Hamilton said. "But in the closing laps, I was struggling massively with tyre degradation and lost three places, finishing P6, which doesn't reflect the pace we had in the car today. "Not every call will work out and I can accept getting it wrong, but I'm sorry for the team for the points we lost today." The dejected seven-times world champion also apologised over the team radio as he brought his car back to the pits after the race. "Sorry boys, I let you down today with that strategy. My call and I lost us valuable points," Hamilton said. "I'll try and make up for it in the next one. Great job with the pit stop though." The missed opportunity was particularly painful given Ferrari's promising pace in Singapore, with Hamilton and Leclerc finishing second and third behind Verstappen in [USN:L1N45W02M TEXT:"Saturday's sprint"]. "Honestly, it's a bit of a shame because he's losing a podium as well," Vasseur said, adding that there was no miscommunication. "He was crystal clear on the radio. But now let's be focused on Austin. The performance this weekend was okay. We have to be focused on the future."

item.title: Monte dei Paschi to hold board meeting on M&A situation on Monday
item.description: Italy's Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena will hold a board meeting late on Monday to take stock of the situation after suitor Intesa Sanpaolo pledged to hike its takeover bid and gained the support of some key MPS investors, three people close to the matter said on Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Italy's Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena (BMPS.MI) will hold a board meeting late on Monday to take stock of the situation after suitor Intesa Sanpaolo (ISP.MI) pledged to hike its takeover bid and gained the support of some key MPS investors, three people close to the matter said on Sunday. Intesa a week ago said it would increase by 25% the cash component of its [USN:L1N45P04T TEXT:"€35 billion takeover"] bid if MPS shareholders rejected a defence plan CEO Luigi Lovaglio has proposed against the bid. The board will discuss the latest developments, one of the sources said, adding it was not clear if any further defence moves could be put to board members. To be able to advance his defence scheme, Lovaglio has called a shareholder vote on it on October 29, where he needs a two-third majority approval. But [USN:L8N45U0BR TEXT:"shareholders"] holding in aggregate some 30% of the bank's capital over the course of the past week said they would not back the project - making it impossible to reach the necessary approval threshold.

item.title: Polícia polonesa detém homem após ameaça ao primeiro-ministro Donald Tusk
item.description: A polícia polonesa deteve um homem suspeito de planejar um ataque contra o primeiro-ministro Donald Tusk, informou o ministro do Interior no domingo, após ter alertado anteriormente sobre uma ameaça contra Tusk e o ministro da Defesa, Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A polícia polonesa deteve um homem suspeito de planejar um ataque contra o primeiro-ministro Donald Tusk, informou o ministro do Interior no domingo, após ter alertado anteriormente sobre uma ameaça contra Tusk e o ministro da Defesa, Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz. “O homem que ameaçou e planejou um ataque contra o primeiro-ministro Donald Tusk foi detido pela polícia polonesa”, escreveu Marcin Kierwinski no X, sem fornecer mais detalhes. Tusk agradeceu à polícia pela “ação rápida e decisiva” em uma postagem separada no X. Embora crimes violentos sejam relativamente raros na Polônia, o país está profundamente polarizado politicamente e tem enfrentado ameaças à segurança devido à sua proximidade com a guerra na Ucrânia. Em agosto, a polícia deteve um homem de 23 anos acusado de incitar o assassinato de políticos poloneses de alto escalão. Em 2024, Tusk afirmou ter recebido ameaças após uma tentativa de assassinato contra o primeiro-ministro eslovaco Robert Fico. A porta-voz do Ministério do Interior Karolina Galecka disse no domingo que um email com informações sobre o possível ataque havia sido encaminhado à polícia pelo Serviço de Proteção do Estado, responsável pela segurança dos ministros.

item.title: 1 Trump dice que Rusia y Ucrania han alcanzado un alto el fuego energético inmediato
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo el domingo que Ucrania y Rusia habían acordado lo que él describió como un "alto el fuego energético", horas después de que el líder ucraniano, Volodímir Zelenski, se opuso a la presión de Washington para poner fin de forma unilateral a los ataques contra las refinerías rusas.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Flynn, Steve Holland
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo el domingo que Ucrania y Rusia habían acordado lo que él describió como un "alto el fuego energético", horas después de que el líder ucraniano, Volodímir Zelenski, se opuso a la presión de Washington para poner fin de forma unilateral a los ataques contra las refinerías rusas. En una publicación en redes sociales, Trump dijo que el alto el fuego energético entraría en vigor de inmediato, pero no dio más detalles. En una entrevista con Axios, Zelenski señaló que la publicación de Trump era la primera vez que oía hablar del acuerdo, aunque un alto cargo ucraniano dijo a Reuters que Ucrania estaba dispuesta a aceptar dicho alto el fuego, si Rusia también lo estaba. Trump, a quien se ha culpado de que la guerra en Irán haya provocado los altos precios del diésel, ya había anunciado a mediados de septiembre un alto el fuego energético en Ucrania, aunque ninguna de las partes confirmó jamás que se hubiera alcanzado. "Con efecto inmediato, hay un ALTO EL FUEGO ENERGÉTICO en la guerra entre Rusia y Ucrania. Ambas partes han dado su consentimiento. ¡No lo rompáis!", escribió Trump en Truth Social. El domingo por la mañana, Zelenski había reiterado la postura anterior de Ucrania: que está dispuesta a detener los ataques contra las refinerías rusas, pero solo si Moscú cesa sus propios ataques contra la infraestructura energética ucraniana. Cualquier acuerdo de este tipo tendría que ir acompañado de "garantías reales", dijo Zelenski. "La verdadera causa de la guerra en Europa es Rusia y solo Rusia", agregó Zelenski. "Es posible detener los ataques contra las infraestructuras energéticas ya desde hoy mismo, pero Putin no quiere hacerlo". En un dramático deterioro de sus relaciones, Trump había advertido el sábado a Zelenski de que "más le valía dejar de una vez" de atacar las refinerías rusas, y había instado a los ucranianos a sustituirlo como líder mediante nuevas elecciones, ya que había desaprovechado varias oportunidades para llegar a un acuerdo con Moscú. En su intervención del domingo en el programa "This Week" de la ABC, Zelenski respondió que organizaría elecciones en Ucrania si el presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin, aceptaba un alto el fuego de 60 días. El líder ucraniano rechazó que se le culpara de las subidas de los precios de la energía, y añadió que "todo el mundo" sabía que la guerra en Oriente Medio era un factor más importante. La fuerte subida de los precios mundiales del diésel, que siguió al estallido de la guerra en Irán en febrero, se ha convertido en un lastre político para el Partido Republicano de Trump antes de las elecciones legislativas, en las que los demócratas de la oposición podrían hacerse con el control de una o ambas cámaras del Congreso. Los analistas han dicho que es poco probable que el acuerdo de suministro de gasóleo de Trump con Moscú provoque una baja sostenida de los precios del combustible, ya que los volúmenes implicados eran pocos. El acuerdo sobre el gasóleo también fue criticado por legisladores estadounidenses, entre ellos uno de los compañeros republicanos de Trump, el diputado Don Bacon, quien sostuvo que era el momento de aplicar más sanciones, no de levantarlas.

item.title: Verstappen, de Red Bull, se alza con su primera victoria en el Gran Premio de Singapur
item.description: Max Verstappen, de Red Bull, tuvo un desempeño dominante el domingo desde la pole position en el Gran Premio de Singapur, que le valió su segunda victoria consecutiva de la temporada tras un fin de semana perfecto en el que también se impuso en la carrera al "sprint".
item.dc:creator: Rohith Nair
item.content:encoded: Max Verstappen, de Red Bull, tuvo un desempeño dominante el domingo desde la pole position en el Gran Premio de Singapur, que le valió su segunda victoria consecutiva de la temporada tras un fin de semana perfecto en el que también se impuso en la carrera al "sprint". El holandés controló la carrera desde el inicio en el Circuito Urbano de Marina Bay, resistiendo un ataque inicial de Charles Leclerc, de Ferrari, que terminó segundo, mientras que Kimi Antonelli, de Mercedes, se hizo con el último puesto del podio. Verstappen, que ganó el Gran Premio de Baréin en Malasia el pasado fin de semana, nunca había ganado antes en Singapur y había llegado al fin de semana de carrera afirmando que tenía "asuntos pendientes". "Ha llevado su tiempo, pero creo que esta carrera ha sido muy buena. Teníamos ritmo cuando lo necesitábamos con los neumáticos blandos, aunque creo que los neumáticos medios nos dieron más problemas a todos", dijo Verstappen. "Pero ha salido bien, así que, por supuesto, estoy muy contento de ganar aquí (...) Las dos últimas carreras han sido muy positivas para nosotros y es fantástico verlo". Antonelli amplió su ventaja en el campeonato sobre su compañero de equipo George Russell a 102 puntos y el italiano puede proclamarse matemáticamente campeón en la próxima prueba, en Austin. "¿Puedo? ¿De verdad?", dijo Antonelli, sorprendido, cuando se lo comunicaron tras su decimocuarto podio de la temporada. "Bueno, no nos preocupemos por eso. Intentemos hacer el mejor fin de semana posible y rematar la faena". Lewis Hamilton, de Ferrari, había conseguido la tercera posición en la parrilla de salida, pero vivió una tarde complicada, cayendo hasta la sexta posición por detrás de Lando Norris y Oscar Piastri después de que los dos pilotos de McLaren le adelantaron en los últimos compases de la carrera, mientras él luchaba con problemas de neumáticos.

item.title: Verstappen vence GP de Cingapura de F1 e Antonelli se aproxima do título
item.description: Max Verstappen, da Red Bull, teve um desempenho dominante e venceu o Grande Prêmio de Cingapura largando da pole position no domingo, garantindo sua segunda vitória consecutiva na temporada da Fórmula 1 após um fim de semana perfeito, que incluiu uma vitória na corrida sprint.
item.dc:creator: Rohith Nair
item.content:encoded: Max Verstappen, da Red Bull, teve um desempenho dominante e venceu o Grande Prêmio de Cingapura largando da pole position no domingo, garantindo sua segunda vitória consecutiva na temporada da Fórmula 1 após um fim de semana perfeito, que incluiu uma vitória na corrida sprint. O holandês controlou a corrida desde o início no Circuito de Rua de Marina Bay, resistindo a um ataque inicial de Charles Leclerc, da Ferrari, que terminou em segundo, enquanto Kimi Antonelli, da Mercedes, ficou em terceiro, aproximando-se do seu primeiro título. Verstappen, que venceu o Grande Prêmio do Barein na Malásia no fim de semana passado, nunca havia vencido em Cingapura antes e chegou ao fim de semana de corrida afirmando que tinha “uma conta a acertar”. "Levou um tempo, mas acho que esta corrida foi muito boa. Tivemos ritmo quando precisávamos com os pneus macios, embora eu ache que os pneus médios tenham sido mais difíceis para todo mundo", disse Verstappen. “Mas deu certo, então é claro que estou muito feliz por vencer aqui... As duas últimas corridas foram realmente positivas para nós e é simplesmente ótimo ver isso.” Antonelli ampliou sua liderança no campeonato sobre o companheiro de equipe George Russell para 102 pontos, e o italiano pode, matematicamente, conquistar o título na próxima etapa, em Austin. “Será mesmo? Sério?”, disse Antonelli, surpreso, quando foi informado disso após seu 14º pódio da temporada. “Bem, não vamos nos preocupar com isso. Vamos tentar fazer o melhor fim de semana possível e concluir o trabalho.” Lewis Hamilton, da Ferrari, havia se classificado em terceiro no grid, mas passou por uma prova difícil, caindo para o sexto lugar atrás de Lando Norris e Oscar Piastri depois que os dois pilotos da McLaren o ultrapassaram nas últimas voltas, enquanto ele enfrentava problemas com os pneus. Russell, que largou na parte de trás do grid devido a penalidades relacionadas ao motor, terminou em nono, atrás de Liam Lawson e Nico Hulkenberg, enquanto Isack Hadjar — que também largou na parte de trás — ficou em 10º.

item.title: Feysa holds off Lokedi to win Chicago Marathon, Kipruto triumphs in men's race
item.description: Ethiopian Hawi Feysa retained her Chicago Marathon crown in a heavyweight clash with Kenya's Sharon Lokedi on Sunday, breaking the tape in two hours, 13 minutes and 33 seconds, while Kenya's Amos Kipruto dominated the men's race in 2:01:09.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ethiopian Hawi Feysa retained her Chicago Marathon crown in a heavyweight clash with Kenya's Sharon Lokedi on Sunday, breaking the tape in two hours, 13 minutes and 33 seconds, while Kenya's Amos Kipruto dominated the men's race in 2:01:09. The back-to-back Boston winner Lokedi (2:14:07) battled with Feysa through much of the final six miles of the course but could not hang on as the Ethiopian slammed her foot on the gas in the final mile. Kenya's Brigid Kosgei was third in 2:14:55. Lokedi and Feysa pulled away from the lead pack around the 30-kilometre mark, taking advantage of pristine conditions on the famously speedy course, before engaging in a tense cat-and-mouse battle that saw them trade the lead on multiple occasions from there. Feysa, who picked up her second bronze finish in Tokyo earlier this year, crumpled after crossing the line, telling a TV reporter she was "elated" with her successful title defence. "It certainly became quite a battle (around 33 kilometres)," she said via a translator. "Around 35k I became pretty sure I had this in the bag." Kipruto exacted revenge in the men's race after his second-place finish a year ago, adding another marathon major title following his London win four years ago. Kipruto finished 91 seconds behind Ugandan Jacob Kiplimo in 2025 but flipped the script this time around, running all by himself through the final straight after a tactically flawless performance. Ethiopian Tadese Bikila crossed the line in 2:02:56 while his compatriot Milkesa Mengesha (2:03:46) was third. Kipruto and Kiplimo (2:04:18) were leading the field by 16 seconds at 30-kilometre mark but the Ugandan fell off the pace shortly after, slipping to fourth as the Kenya cruised through much of the last chunk of the course alone. "I was here to fight," said Kipruto. Everything is all about the mindset. It was a tough field but I set my mind on it, I said 'Let's go.'" Switzerland's Catherine Debrunner shattered her own women's wheelchair world record, breaking the tape in 1:33:16 to knock a minute off the previous mark she set in Berlin three years ago. Her compatriot Marcel Hug collected his seventh Chicago Marathon win in the men's wheelchair race in a course record 1:21:34. "The crowd definitely helped me so much," said Debrunner. "I'm pretty speechless, to be honest, I had no expected to make a world record here at all."

item.title: Trump afirma que Rússia e Ucrânia chegaram a “cessar-fogo energético”
item.description: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmou no domingo que Ucrânia e Rússia chegaram a um acordo sobre o que ele descreveu como um “cessar-fogo energético”.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmou no domingo que Ucrânia e Rússia chegaram a um acordo sobre o que ele descreveu como um “cessar-fogo energético”. Trump, em uma postagem nas redes sociais, disse que o cessar-fogo energético entra em vigor imediatamente, mas não deu mais detalhes. Não houve confirmação imediata por parte de Kiev ou Moscou.

item.title: Papa Leão anuncia que será submetido a cirurgia para remover pequeno nódulo no pulmão
item.description: O papa Leão afirmou no domingo que médicos detectaram um pequeno nódulo em seu pulmão durante um exame médico recente e que ele será submetido a uma cirurgia nesta semana para removê-lo, no primeiro susto relacionado à saúde do pontífice de 71 anos durante seu pontificado.
item.dc:creator: Joshua McElwee
item.content:encoded: O papa Leão afirmou no domingo que médicos detectaram um pequeno nódulo em seu pulmão durante um exame médico recente e que ele será submetido a uma cirurgia nesta semana para removê-lo, no primeiro susto relacionado à saúde do pontífice de 71 anos durante seu pontificado. Leão disse aos peregrinos na Praça de São Pedro, durante sua oração dominical semanal, que o nódulo é “bem delimitado” e havia sido detectado precocemente. O Vaticano não informou se acredita-se que o nódulo seja maligno. “Recentemente, durante alguns exames médicos, os médicos encontraram um nódulo localizado no meu pulmão”, disse o pontífice. “Ele foi detectado em um estágio muito inicial e está bem contido.” “Os médicos acreditam que é aconselhável intervir; portanto, seguindo suas recomendações, decidi me submeter a uma cirurgia para removê-lo”, declarou ele. “A operação já está marcada para os próximos dias.” Um nódulo no pulmão é uma pequena lesão localizada que pode ser benigna. A Sociedade Torácica Americana afirma que menos de 5% dos nódulos pulmonares, em geral, se revelam cancerosos, embora o risco aumente com a idade, o tamanho e outros fatores, como o tabagismo. “Nódulos pulmonares são bastante comuns e costumam ser benignos”, disse Stephen Liu, especialista em câncer de pulmão da Universidade de Georgetown, em Washington, e chefe da divisão de hematologia-oncologia do MedStar Georgetown University Hospital. “Quando há motivo suficiente para preocupação e quando é seguro fazê-lo, com base na localização do nódulo e no estado geral de saúde do paciente, a remoção cirúrgica pode fornecer um diagnóstico definitivo”, afirmou ele. Leão, eleito papa pelos cardeais de todo o mundo em maio de 2025, é relativamente jovem para um líder da Igreja. Ele gosta de praticar esportes, incluindo tênis, e não é conhecido por ser fumante nem por ter tido problemas de saúde anteriormente. A primeira-ministra italiana, Giorgia Meloni, desejou melhoras ao papa. “Gostaria de expressar ao Santo Padre meu apoio pessoal, e o do governo italiano, enquanto ele enfrenta esse desafio nos próximos dias”, disse ela em um comunicado. “A serenidade e a compostura com que ele falou sobre isso (hoje)... são tranquilizadoras”, acrescentou Meloni. O papa Francisco, predecessor de Leão, morreu aos 88 anos. Ele foi hospitalizado várias vezes à medida que sua saúde se tornava mais frágil nos últimos anos. Ele geralmente não anunciava suas internações com antecedência, o que às vezes provocava um frenesi da mídia em relação à sua saúde. A assessoria de imprensa do Vaticano informou que a recuperação de Leão após a cirurgia deve levar cerca de uma semana. Não foram fornecidos imediatamente mais detalhes sobre a saúde do papa.

item.title: Trump says Russia and Ukraine reached 'energy ceasefire'
item.description: There was no immediate confirmation from Kyiv or Moscow.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump said on Sunday that Ukraine and Russia had agreed to what he described as an "energy ceasefire." Trump, in a social media post, said the energy ceasefire was taking effect immediately, but did not elaborate further. There was no immediate confirmation from Kyiv or Moscow.

item.title: Pologne-Un homme arrêté après des menaces visant Tusk et le ministre de la Défense
item.description: La police polonaise a arrêté un homme soupçonné de préparer une attaque contre le Premier ministre Donald Tusk et le ministre de la Défense Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz, a annoncé dimanche le ministre de l'Intérieur.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La police polonaise a arrêté un homme soupçonné de préparer une attaque contre le Premier ministre Donald Tusk et le ministre de la Défense Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz, a annoncé dimanche le ministre de l'Intérieur. Marcin Kierwinski a précisé à la chaîne publique TVP Info que l'homme était âgé d'une soixantaine d'années et avait été interpellé dans la région de Basse-Silésie, dans le sud de la Pologne. "Les services de sécurité l'ont identifié grâce à une analyse détaillée de contenus publiés en ligne", a-t-il ajouté. Donald Tusk et Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz, dans des messages publiés sur X, ont remercié la police pour sa réaction "rapide et déterminée". Si les crimes violents sont relativement rares en Pologne, le pays est profondément polarisé sur le plan politique et est confronté à des menaces sécuritaires en raison de sa proximité avec la guerre en Ukraine. En août, la police a interpellé un homme de 23 ans accusé d'avoir appelé à l'assassinat de hauts responsables politiques polonais. En 2024, Donald Tusk avait déclaré avoir reçu des menaces après une tentative d'assassinat du Premier ministre slovaque Robert Fico. Les autorités polonaises sont en état d'alerte après une série d'actes de violence dans des établissements scolaires qui a conduit à la mort d'un agent d'entretien jeudi.

item.title: Ukraine's Zelenskiy tells ABC he will organize elections if Russia agrees to 60-day ceasefire
item.description: "Please tell Putin, give us two months," Zelenskiy told ABC's "This Week."
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Sunday in response to critical comments from US President Donald Trump that he will organize elections in Ukraine if Russian President Vladimir Putin agrees to a 60-day ceasefire. "Please tell Putin, give us two months, 60 days of total ceasefire, 60 days, and we will organize elections," Zelenskiy told ABC's "This Week." Trump on Saturday criticized Zelenskiy for attacking Russian oil refineries a day after the US temporarily lifted sanctions on Russian fuel that were designed to deprive Moscow of revenues to fund its war in Ukraine . "I think it's time for Ukraine to get a new president," Trump had told reporters at the White House. In response, Zelenskiy said "it's up to Ukrainians" to choose their leader and noted that Putin would also like to change who is leading Ukraine. He said it is easy for Ukraine to be blamed for higher fuel prices "when everybody in the world understands because of the war in (the) Middle East , the prices are rising." Earlier on Sunday, Zelenskiy said Ukraine was [USN:L1N45X021 TEXT:"ready to halt"] attacks on Russian oil refineries if Moscow ceases its own strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure. Under terms of the deal as described by Trump on Friday, Russia will immediately supply more than 300,000 metric tons of diesel to US and global markets, equal to about 2.25 million barrels of fuel. The US exports about 1.5 million barrels of diesel per day. Trump is under pressure to bring down rising fuel prices ahead of November midterm elections that will determine whether his Republican Party will retain control of the US Congress for his final two years in office. Many lawmakers, including Republicans, have criticized the diesel deal as rewarding Putin.

item.title: Verstappen cruises to first Singapore GP win as Antonelli closes on crown
item.description: It was Max Verstappen's first win in Singapore.
item.dc:creator: Rohith Nair
item.content:encoded: Red Bull's Max Verstappen delivered a commanding performance to win the Singapore Grand Prix from pole position on Sunday, securing his second straight victory of the season after a perfect weekend that included a [USN:L1N45W02M TEXT:"sprint race triumph"]. The Dutchman controlled the race from the start at the Marina Bay Street Circuit, fending off an early challenge from Ferrari's Charles Leclerc who finished second while Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli was third to close in on a first title. Verstappen, who won the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia last weekend, had never won in Singapore before and he had come into the race weekend stating he had "unfinished business". "It's taken a while but I think this race was very good. We had pace when we needed to have it on the soft tyre, even though I think the medium tyre for everyone was more of a struggle," Verstappen said. "But it worked out, so of course very happy to win here... The last two races have been really positive for us and it's just great to see." Antonelli extended his championship lead over teammate George Russell to 102 points and the Italian can mathematically win the title in the next round in Austin. "Can I? Really?" a surprised Antonelli said when he was told after his 14th podium of the season. "Well, let's not worry about that. Let's try to do the best weekend as possible and finish the job." Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton had qualified third on the grid but he endured a torrid evening, slipping to sixth behind Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri after the two McLaren drivers overtook him in the dying stages as he struggled with his tyres. Russell, who started at the back of the grid due to engine penalties, finished ninth behind Liam Lawson and Nico Hulkenberg while Isack Hadjar - who also started at the back - was 10th. VERSTAPPEN SHUTS THE DOOR Leclerc reacted faster than polesitter Verstappen at the start, nearly lining up alongside the Dutchman heading into turn one, but the Red Bull driver veered to the left to shut the door on the Ferrari and retain his lead. As the race progressed, Verstappen steadily pulled clear on soft tyres, with Red Bull urging him to manage their life as Ferrari threatened an undercut. Hamilton's struggles became apparent early as he lost pace on medium tyres in third place and Ferrari brought him in for softs before Leclerc pitted on lap 25 in a move timed to emerge ahead of his teammate. Hamilton's frustration boiled over on team radio as he urged Ferrari to let him past Leclerc, saying: "I need to use this speed, mate," before Leclerc responded by setting the fastest lap. When Verstappen finally pitted on lap 33, his commanding lead allowed him to rejoin in first place. Lance Stroll's retirement with clutch issues triggered another VSC period that sparked a flurry of pit stops and Russell's timing proved unfortunate as the VSC ended earlier than expected, dropping him to 10th. RADIO ISSUES FOR VERSTAPPEN The strategy chaos benefited Leclerc, who caught and passed Hamilton on lap 46 to claim second place, though he remained nearly 15 seconds behind Verstappen, who faced radio communication problems for the second time this weekend. The issue forced his engineer to resort to coded messages, asking the Dutchman to key his mic to make a sound or stay silent when given options on strategy. The final stint saw Hamilton's pace collapse as multiple drivers closed in sensing a podium. Norris attempted to pass Hamilton on lap 54, but the Ferrari left the track and went wide while the McLaren went on the dirty part of the track, allowing Antonelli to overtake and move up to fourth. Antonelli then passed Hamilton for third before Norris found his opportunity at turn 10. Hamilton's misery was completed when Piastri overtook him on the final lap, relegating the Ferrari driver to sixth place.

item.title: Volkswagen CEO says transformation is 'shared responsibility' in appeal to EU
item.description: In his speech at the Paris auto show, Oliver Blume backed proposed "Made in Europe" rules and welcomed an EU-China deal that could cut Chinese imports of plug-in hybrid vehicles to the bloc by more than half.
item.dc:creator: Rachel More
item.content:encoded: Volkswagen chief Oliver Blume expects European policymakers to create the framework needed to make the German automaker's restructuring a success, he said on Sunday, amid a push by Brussels to shield industry from low-cost Chinese competitors. At an event titled "For Europe" on the eve of the Paris motor show, Blume said Volkswagen was working to reduce complexity across the company, whose brands range from mass-market VW to high-end marques like Porsche and Lamborghini, in what he called "the biggest transformation programme in our history". "This is a shared responsibility: The business community must become more competitive and create attractive opportunities, while policymakers must establish the right framework conditions," he said. PRICE WAR IN ELECTRIC VEHICLES The auto show in Paris comes at a critical juncture for Europe's top carmaker, which is undergoing a major restructuring and is racing to update its mass-market electric vehicle offering as Chinese competitors rapidly gain ground in Europe. Battered by an EV price war and falling sales at home, Chinese automakers are aggressively expanding into Europe. In his speech, Blume backed proposed "Made in Europe" rules to incentivise local manufacturing, and welcomed [USN:L6N45V0LF TEXT:"a deal"] between the EU and China that could cut Chinese imports of plug-in hybrid vehicles to the bloc by more than half. "Those who sell here should compete under comparable conditions and create jobs and value here in Europe too," Blume said at the event, attended by France's minister for industry Sebastien Martin. Battling to implement sweeping job cuts and threatening to close up to four plants in Germany, Blume also faces pressure from investors to prove his [USN:L8N44W0B8 TEXT:"turnaround strategy"] goes beyond downsizing to make strides in product development and software. A suite of affordable EVs across Volkswagen's volume brands, including VW, Spain's Cupra and the Czech Republic's Skoda, will be on show at the event. Volkswagen will also premiere its new ID. Tiguan electric SUV. Volkswagen is by far Europe's top-selling automaker, with a consistent market share of roughly a quarter over the last decade, even as Chinese entrants like BYD (002594.SZ) and Leapmotor (9863.HK) build a following. Still, Volkswagen is feeling the heat. Its CEO is among German auto industry leaders [USN:L8N44O0MW TEXT:"calling for"] a more protectionist EU stance, as fears of retaliation from Beijing give way to worries that brutal competition in China has spread to Europe. EUROPEAN MARKET 'COULD BECOME VERY UNPROFITABLE' Gregor Williams, an analyst at Rhodium Group, said: "Industry has become a lot more concerned about the competitive challenge arising in China." The downturn in China's domestic auto market is creating export pressure, Williams said. "It's one thing to lose revenues," he added. "But if China also manages to export the price war, the European market could become very unprofitable."

item.title: Nuevo ataque contra aeropuerto de Riad provoca incendio, un día después de otro en que murieron 12
item.description: La coalición liderada por Arabia Saudita en Yemen dijo que un "proyectil no identificado" había impactado el domingo en el aeropuerto internacional de Riad, provocando un incendio, pocas horas después de que los hutíes, respaldados por Irán, advirtieron a las compañías aéreas y a los viajeros que se mantuvieran alejados de los aeropuertos sauditas .
item.dc:creator: Jana Choukeir, Maha Dahan, Timour Azhari
item.content:encoded: La coalición liderada por Arabia Saudita en Yemen dijo que un "proyectil no identificado" había impactado el domingo en el aeropuerto internacional de Riad, provocando un incendio, pocas horas después de que los hutíes, respaldados por Irán, advirtieron a las compañías aéreas y a los viajeros que se mantuvieran alejados de los aeropuertos sauditas . La coalición también dijo que las defensas aéreas sauditas habían interceptado un misil de crucero en las inmediaciones del Aeropuerto Internacional Rey Khalid. No se facilitaron más detalles de inmediato. El aeropuerto permanece cerrado tras el ataque del sábado, en el que murieron 12 personas y más de 300 resultaron heridas, el ataque más mortífero de este tipo contra el reino en más de una década, en un contexto de una escalada de los combates entre los hutíes y las fuerzas gubernamentales yemeníes. A pesar del cierre temporal del aeropuerto, el Ministerio de Energía saudita dijo que una conferencia internacional sobre energía, prevista desde hacía tiempo, seguiría celebrándose en Riad el domingo. La coalición liderada por Arabia Saudita en Yemen informó de que el proyectil del domingo tenía como objetivo la Terminal 4 del aeropuerto, sin dar más detalles. "Reiteramos nuestra advertencia a todas las compañías aéreas, expertos, empleados, trabajadores y viajeros para que no usen los aeropuertos ni el espacio aéreo sauditas, ya que son vulnerables a los ataques y se han convertido en un teatro de operaciones para nuestras fuerzas, con la excepción de los aeropuertos de (las ciudades santas de) La Meca y Medina", habían dicho antes los hutíes en una publicación en X. Arabia Saudita ha intensificado su intervención militar en Yemen en las últimas semanas, lanzando ataques contra los hutíes y respaldando una contraofensiva del Gobierno yemení después de que el grupo respaldado por Irán se hizo con territorio estratégico en la costa del mar Rojo el mes pasado. El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de Yemen, controlado por los hutíes, dijo el domingo que cualquier nueva acción militar saudita en Yemen provocaría una respuesta más contundente, y añadió que sus acciones se regirían por el principio de reciprocidad.

WARSAW: Polish police have detained a man suspected of planning an attack on Prime Minister Donald Tusk, the Interior Minister said on Sunday (Oct 11), after it warned earlier of a threat to Tusk and Defence Minister Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz. "The man who threatened and planned an attack on Prime Minister Donald Tusk has been detained by Polish police," Marcin Kierwinski wrote on X, without giving further details. Tusk thanked the police for "swift and decisive action" in a separate post on X. Polish security services earlier convened a special meeting after receiving information about a potential attack, a spokesperson said.

Special services spokesperson Jacek Dobrzynski said he could not go into details but authorities were treating the threat as "deadly serious". "We are talking about a high probability of these threats being carried out," he told reporters. Interior Ministry Spokesperson Karolina Galecka said an email with information about the potential attack had been forwarded to police by the State Protection Service, which is responsible for ministers' security. While violent crime is relatively rare in Poland, the country is deeply polarised politically and has faced security threats due to its proximity to the war in Ukraine. In August, police detained a 23-year-old man accused of calling for the assassination of senior Polish politicians. In 2024, Tusk said he received threats after an assassination attempt on Slovak Prime Minister Robert Fico.

item.title: Sheinbaum pide a poblaciones costeras de México refugiarse ante cercanía de huracán Simón
item.description: La presidenta de México, Claudia Sheinbaum, instó a los residentes de las poblaciones de la costa del Pacífico mexicano a permanecer bajo techo este domingo mientras el poderoso huracán Simón, de categoría 4, se acercaba a tierra, amenazando con vientos destructivos, peligrosas marejadas ciclónicas e inundaciones potencialmente mortales.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La presidenta de México, Claudia Sheinbaum, instó a los residentes de las poblaciones de la costa del Pacífico mexicano a permanecer bajo techo este domingo mientras el poderoso huracán Simón, de categoría 4, se acercaba a tierra, amenazando con vientos destructivos, peligrosas marejadas ciclónicas e inundaciones potencialmente mortales. Simón se encontraba a unos 105 km al oeste-noroeste de la ciudad portuaria Manzanillo, en el estado Colima, con vientos máximos sostenidos de 230 km/h, según informó el Centro Nacional de Huracanes (CNH) de Estados Unidos en su último boletín de las 9:00 hora local (1500 GMT). El huracán se desplazaba hacia el nor-noroeste a 11 km/h, con su centro situado a unos 140 km al sur-sureste de Cabo Corrientes, en el vecino estado de Jalisco. "Ante el próximo impacto del huracán Simón categoría 4, exhortamos a la población de municipios costeros de Jalisco, Colima, Nayarit y Michoacán a mantenerse en resguardo hasta el aviso oficial de que el peligro ha terminado", dijo Sheinbaum en una publicación en X. La mandataria indicó que continuaban las evacuaciones preventivas hacia zonas más seguras y exhortó a la población a no salir a la calle y a seguir las instrucciones de Protección Civil. El CNH informó que Simón podría tocar tierra entre Playa Perula y Cabo Corrientes en las próximas 12 a 18 horas, aunque un cambio en su trayectoria proyectada hacia el oeste planteaba la posibilidad de que el centro de la tormenta permaneciera en alta mar. Incluso sin tocar tierra directamente, era probable que se registraran vientos catastróficos y marejadas ciclónicas que amenazaran vidas a lo largo de partes de la costa centro-occidental de México, advirtió la agencia. Las autoridades mexicanas han declarado el nivel máximo de alerta en 28 municipios de Jalisco y Colima, mientras que otros 93 municipios se encuentran bajo alerta alta, según informes de medios locales. El aeropuerto internacional de la localidad turística Puerto Vallarta ha cerrado temporalmente, al tiempo que las autoridades han suspendido actividades no esenciales y habilitado refugios de emergencia en las comunidades costeras amenazadas. El CNH advirtió que las fuertes lluvias previstas hasta el lunes podrían provocar inundaciones y deslizamientos de tierra potencialmente mortales, especialmente en zonas montañosas. Simón se intensificó rápidamente hasta convertirse en un huracán de categoría 4 el sábado, lo que llevó a las autoridades a desplegar personal militar, equipos de emergencia y brigadas de protección civil en las comunidades costeras vulnerables. "SE INUNDÓ TODA LA CASA" El sábado en Manzanillo, una ciudad portuaria clave, los residentes se mostraban mayormente tranquilos a pesar de la tormenta que se aproximaba, sin señales evidentes de compras de pánico en los supermercados. Algunos comercios habían comenzado a proteger sus escaparates con tablones, mientras los negocios cerraban y las calles permanecían relativamente vacías. El personal de Protección Civil había clausurado las playas, instalado barreras y colocado banderas de advertencia rojas y negras, instando a los habitantes a mantenerse alejados de la costa. Durante la noche y la madrugada, Simon se desvió de su trayectoria directa hacia tierra firme, evitando parte de los daños previstos, aunque aun así trajo lluvias y vientos que provocaron inundaciones y desperfectos en Manzanillo. Se desplegaron efectivos policiales y militares por toda la ciudad. Hacia el final de la mañana del domingo, cuando parecía haber pasado lo peor de la tormenta, los residentes comenzaron a retirar el agua que, según relataron, había empezado a inundar sus hogares de madrugada. En el barrio de La Alameda, una zona en el sur de la ciudad, los vecinos caminaban con dificultad entre aguas que les llegaban a las espinillas, mientras miembros del Ejército, junto con las familias, sacaban con cubos el agua de las viviendas hacia la calle. “Las camas, los refrigeradores, las estufas, todos los muebles se mojaron, se inundó toda la casa”, dijo a Reuters Cecilia Palomar, a las puertas de su hogar. “Mi mamá no quiere salir, la llevamos con mi hermano, a lo más alto. Es una señora ya mayor, pero no quiere salir. No quiere estar lejos de su casa”. María Elena Vázquez relató que su casa comenzó a llenarse de agua hacia las cinco de la mañana y no escondió su malestar por los sucedido. "(Estamos) mal, muy mal, y con enfermos", afirmó. La tormenta llega una semana después de que el huracán Polo azotara la península mexicana Baja California como huracán de categoría 2, derribando árboles y postes de tendido eléctrico e inundando calles.

item.title: Pope Leo to undergo surgery for small growth on lung
item.description: VATICAN CITY: Pope Leo said on Sunday (Oct 11) that doctors had detected a small growth on his lung during a recent health check and he would be undergoing surgery this week to remove it, in the first health scare of the 71-year-old pontiff's tenure.Pope Leo told pilgrims in St. Peter's Square for his weekly

Pope Leo to undergo surgery for small growth on lung

Pope Leo celebrates Mass marking the start of the academic year at the Pontifical Universities in St. Peter's Basilica at the Vatican, Oct 8, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Remo Casilli)

11 Oct 2026 07:28PM (Updated: 11 Oct 2026 07:50PM)

VATICAN CITY: Pope Leo said on Sunday (Oct 11) that doctors had detected a small growth on his lung during a recent health check and he would be undergoing surgery this week to remove it, in the first health scare of the 71-year-old pontiff's tenure. Pope Leo told pilgrims in St. Peter's Square for his weekly Sunday prayer that the growth was "well-contained" and had been spotted early. The Vatican did not say whether the nodule is believed to be malignant. "Recently, during some medical examinations, doctors found a localised nodule in my lung," said the pontiff. "It was detected at a very early stage and is well contained."

"The doctors believe it is advisable to intervene, so, following their advice, I have decided to undergo surgery to remove it," he said. "The operation is already scheduled for the next few days." A nodule on the lung is a small, localised lesion that can be benign. The American Thoracic Society says fewer than 5 per cent of lung nodules overall prove cancerous, although risk rises with age, size and other factors such as smoking. Pope Leo, elected pope by the world's cardinals in May 2025, is relatively young for a Church leader. He enjoys sports, including tennis, and is not known to be a smoker or to previously have had health issues.

Related:

Pope Leo warns that AI is creating 'paradise of machines'

Pope Leo urges concessions for peace as Ukraine war drags on

Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni wished the pope well. "I would like to express to the Holy Father my personal support, and that of the Italian government, as he faces this challenge in the coming days," she said in a statement. "The serenity and composure with which he spoke about it during today’s Angelus are reassuring," Meloni added. The late Pope Francis, Pope Leo's predecessor, died at age 88 and was increasingly frail in his later years. The Vatican press office said the pope's recovery from surgery was expected to take about a week. It did not immediately provide further details about the pope's health. Pope Leo keeps a busy schedule and is due to make an 11-day tour of Uruguay, Argentina and Peru from Nov 6 to 17. Before mentioning his health issue in his address on Sunday, the pope referred to the trip, thanking Catholics for their prayers "for the pastoral visit I will undertake".

Source: Reuters/fh
